conditions.sampling: server defaults = generation_config.json (temperature 0.9, top_p 1.0, top_k 50, repetition_penalty 1.05)
conditions.rate_unit: zh: CJK characters, en: words, per second of voiced audio (leading/trailing silence removed by a 10 ms frame energy threshold: max-35 dB, floor -55 dBFS)
conditions.outlier_rule: rate < 0.6 x the median rate of the same sentence
